text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A after a modest gain while holding B, D, and E through steep losses suggests I should not let recent price moves alone dictate my decisions.","My average cost is not a reason to keep a losing stock; I should reassess its outlook and set clear limits before losses become severe.","The account kept falling while I rarely reviewed it, so I should schedule periodic check-ins and act when my original reasons for holding a stock no longer apply."]}
